title: Morphisms of locally ringed topoi on small etale topoi come from morphisms of schemes
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The theorem is the fully faithfulness statement that the construction sending a scheme to its small etale topos with structure sheaf is fully faithful: every morphism of locally ringed topoi comes from a unique morphism of schemes, up to a 2-isomorphism (statement lines 5552-5571). The proof is a long gluing argument: the author first treats the case of an affine target, composing with localization morphisms and applying the affine case over an affine open covering of the source (proof lines 5584-5620); then covers the target by affine opens and observes that the local morphisms agree on overlaps by rigidity, producing a global morphism of schemes (proof lines 5620-5688); finally the 2-isomorphisms are glued by the same rigidity and uniqueness is recorded (proof lines 5688-5693). The non-formal content is the gluing both of the morphisms and of the 2-isomorphisms. The claim is H2: a structured construction carried out in two stages with the rigidity input named.
